data.title: The work that keeps software healthy
data.text: Software needs regular care. Without it, small issues turn into outages, security risks and expensive rebuilds.

items.title: Monitoring
items.text: Uptime and error alerts so issues are caught early.

items.title: Security updates
items.text: Framework, plugin and dependency updates applied safely.

items.title: Backups
items.text: Regular backups of code, database and files.

items.title: Bug fixes
items.text: Problems investigated and fixed by people who know the code.

items.title: Performance
items.text: Speed and resource checks as traffic and data grow.

items.title: Improvements
items.text: Time for new features, integrations and design tweaks.

data.title: Three levels of care
data.text: Every plan is quoted for your product. Tell us what you run and we will recommend the right level.

items.text: Send a request on WhatsApp, email or your shared board.

items.title: Prioritise
items.text: We confirm urgency and agree what happens first.

items.title: Fix or build
items.text: Changes tested on a staging copy before going live.

items.title: Report back
items.text: You get a note of what changed and anything to watch.

items.q: Do you support products you did not build?
items.a: Yes. We start with a short review of the code and hosting, then confirm which plan fits.

items.q: How much does a care plan cost?
items.a: It depends on the size of the product and how much improvement time you need. We send a written quote after a short review.

items.q: Can we change plans later?
items.a: Yes. You can move between plans as your needs change.

items.q: What if something urgent breaks?
items.a: Urgent issues on live products are prioritised ahead of improvement work.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract?
items.a: Terms are agreed with each client and written into the proposal before anything starts.

items.q: Can you work with our existing stack?
items.a: Yes. We work on any stack, so we can extend what you already have instead of forcing a rewrite.

items.q: Do you build AI agents and RAG systems?
items.a: Yes. We build AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM features and RAG knowledge assistants, connected to your data and tools.

items.q: Why do you prefer cross-platform mobile?
items.a: One codebase for iOS and Android reduces cost and keeps both apps in sync, with near-native performance.

items.q: Which cloud do you use?
items.a: It depends on your budget and needs. We deploy to AWS, DigitalOcean, Vercel and managed hosting.

items.q: Can you build with WordPress or Shopify?
items.a: Yes, when they are the right fit. We also build custom when your needs outgrow them.

data.content:
Information we collect

We collect the contact details and project information you submit through our website, email, phone or WhatsApp.

How we use information

We use it to respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, deliver services, improve our website, and meet legal obligations.

Data retention and sharing

We keep information only as long as needed and never sell personal data. Trusted service providers, such as hosting and email, may process it on our behalf.

Client project data

Data inside client projects is handled under the confidentiality terms of each project agreement, including NDAs where agreed.

Your choices

Email hello@logicsgrid.org or call +92 329 0112060 to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information.
